20261121-physics-g08-1.title: Marka biyo iyo saliid cunto oo isku mass

20261121-physics-g08-1.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Marka biyo iyo saliid cunto oo isku mass si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261121-physics-g08-1.material: Marka biyo iyo saliid cunto oo isku mass ah lagu kululeeyo koronto-kululeeye isku xoog ah, maxay tahay sababta heerkulka saliiddu uga dhaqso badan u kacayso kan biyaha?
20261121-physics-g08-1.thinking.0: Marka biyo iyo saliid cunto oo isku mass
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.prompt: Marka biyo iyo saliid cunto oo isku mass ah lagu kululeeyo koronto-kululeeye isku xoog ah, maxay tahay sababta heerkulka saliiddu uga dhaqso badan u kacayso kan biyaha?
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.explain: Kuleylka $Q = cm\Delta T$, isbeddelka heerkulka waa $\Delta T = \frac{Q}{cm}$. Biyuhu waa walax specific heat aad u weyn leh, sidaas darteed saliidda specific heat-keedu yar yahay heerkulkeeda aad ayuu u kacaa.
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.hint.0: Specific heat waa kuleylka loo baahan yahay si 1 kg walax ah heerkulkeeda loogu kordhiyo 1℃.
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.hint.1: Walaxda specific heat-keedu yar yahay, marka isla kuleyl la siiyo heerkulkeedu si dhaqso ah ayuu u kacaa.
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.o.o0: Sababtoo ah kuleylka gaarka ah (specific heat) ee saliiddu wuu ka yar yahay kan biyaha
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.o.o1: Sababtoo ah kuleylka gaarka ah ee saliiddu aad buu uga weyn yahay kan biyaha
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.o.o2: Sababtoo ah biyuhu kuleyl ma nuugaan
20261121-physics-g08-1.s.s1.o.o3: Sababtoo ah saliiddu waxay gudbisaa koronto
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.prompt: Marka biyo iyo saliid cunto oo isku mass ah lagu kululeeyo koronto-kululeeye isku xoog ah, maxay tahay sababta heerkulka saliiddu uga dhaqso badan u kacayso kan biyaha?
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.explain: Kuleylka $Q = cm\Delta T$, isbeddelka heerkulka waa $\Delta T = \frac{Q}{cm}$. Biyuhu waa walax specific heat aad u weyn leh, sidaas darteed saliidda specific heat-keedu yar yahay heerkulkeeda aad ayuu u kacaa.
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.hints.0: Specific heat waa kuleylka loo baahan yahay si 1 kg walax ah heerkulkeeda loogu kordhiyo 1℃.
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.hints.1: Walaxda specific heat-keedu yar yahay, marka isla kuleyl la siiyo heerkulkeedu si dhaqso ah ayuu u kacaa.
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.options.0.text: Sababtoo ah kuleylka gaarka ah (specific heat) ee saliiddu wuu ka yar yahay kan biyaha
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.options.1.text: Sababtoo ah kuleylka gaarka ah ee saliiddu aad buu uga weyn yahay kan biyaha
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.options.2.text: Sababtoo ah biyuhu kuleyl ma nuugaan
20261121-physics-g08-1.steps.0.options.3.text: Sababtoo ah saliiddu waxay gudbisaa koronto

20261121-physics-g08-2.title: Marka la dhisayo rail-ka tareenka
20261121-physics-g08-2.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Marka la dhisayo rail-ka tareenka si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261121-physics-g08-2.material: Marka la dhisayo rail-ka tareenka, waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee farqi (god) joogto ah loo dhaafo isku xirka rail-yada?
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Marka la dhisayo rail-ka tareenka, waa maxay sababta cilmiga ee farqi (god) joogto ah loo dhaafo isku xirka rail-yada?
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Macdanta marka heerkulku kordho, dhererkeedu wuu kordhaa sababta thermal expansion-ka. Haddii aan farqi la dhex dhigin isku xirka, rail-yada xagaaga kordhay way is riixi lahaayeen oo waxay keeni karaan shil tareen.
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: Walxaha adag intooda badan, marka heerkulku kordho mugga iyo dhererku way kordhaan.
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.hint.1: Waa meel firaaqo ah oo loogu diyaar garoobo kordhinta kuleylka.
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o0: Si looga hortago in rail-ku qallooco xagaaga marka heerkulku kor u kaco sababta kordhinta kuleylka ee birta
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o1: Si loo xoojiyo cod-ka marka tareenku maro
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o2: Si loo caawiyo in rail-ku sii dheeraado jiilaalka
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o3: Si loo yareeyo culeyska rail-ka tareenka

20261122-physics-g08-1.title: Falanqaynta wareegga
20261122-physics-g08-1.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Falanqaynta wareegga si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261122-physics-g08-1.material: [Falanqaynta wareegga] Laba iska caabbin oo 6 Ω iyo 3 Ω ah ayaa si parallel ah loo xiray, kadibna loo xiray magaalo danab ah 12 V. Waa imisa wadarta korontada ku socota wareeggan oo dhan?
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.prompt: [Falanqaynta wareegga] Laba iska caabbin oo 6 Ω iyo 3 Ω ah ayaa si parallel ah loo xiray, kadibna loo xiray magaalo danab ah 12 V. Waa imisa wadarta korontada ku socota wareeggan oo dhan?
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.explain: Iska caabbinta isku-dhafan ee parallel-ka waa $\frac{1}{R_p} = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2} \implies R_p = 2\,\Omega$. Wadarta korontadu waa $I = \frac{12\text{ V}}{2\,\Omega} = 6\text{ A}$.
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.hint.0: Iska caabbinta isku-dhafan ee parallel-ka: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/3 = 3/6 = 1/2, sidaas darteed R = 2 Ω.
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.hint.1: Xisaabi wadarta korontada I = V / R = 12 / 2.
20261122-physics-g08-1.steps.0.prompt: [Falanqaynta wareegga] Laba iska caabbin oo 6 Ω iyo 3 Ω ah ayaa si parallel ah loo xiray, kadibna loo xiray magaalo danab ah 12 V. Waa imisa wadarta korontada ku socota wareeggan oo dhan?

20261122-physics-g08-1.steps.0.hints.1: Xisaabi wadarta korontada I = V / R = 12 / 2.

20261122-physics-g08-2.title: Thermos-ka ka ilaaliya cabitaannada kulul
20261122-physics-g08-2.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Thermos-ka ka ilaaliya cabitaannada kulul si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261122-physics-g08-2.material: Thermos-ka ka ilaaliya cabitaannada kulul muddo dheer wuxuu leeyahay 'faaruq' u dhexeeya labadiisa gidaar iyo 'dahab-qurxin lacag ah' gidaarka gudaha. Doodee ayaa si sax ah isugu xidhay sifo kasta iyo nooca gudbinta kulaylka ee ay xannibto?
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Thermos-ka ka ilaaliya cabitaannada kulul muddo dheer wuxuu leeyahay 'faaruq' u dhexeeya labadiisa gidaar iyo 'dahab-qurxin lacag ah' gidaarka gudaha. Doodee ayaa si sax ah isugu xidhay sifo kasta iyo nooca gudbinta kulaylka ee ay xannibto?
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Lakabka faaruqa ma laha dhexdhexaad, sidaas darteed gebi ahaanba wuu xannibaa gudbinta kulaylka ee conduction iyo convection, halka gidaarka dhalaalaya ee lacagta ah uu milicsado kulaylka shucaaca ee infrared ah oo gudaha ku celiyo, isagoo ka hortagaya luminta kulaylka.
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: Faaruqu ma laha walax, sidaas darteed wuxuu ka hortagaa conduction iyo convection oo u baahan walax.
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.hint.1: Lacag-dahabaysku wuxuu milicsadaa kulaylka shucaaca, kaas oo ah mowjad korontada-magnetiga (infrared).
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o0: Gidaarka faaruqa: wuxuu xannibaa gudbinta (conduction) iyo convection / Gudaha lacagta ah: wuxuu xannibaa luminta kulaylka ee radiation
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o1: Gidaarka faaruqa: wuxuu xannibaa radiation / Gudaha lacagta ah: wuxuu xannibaa conduction
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o3: Labaduba waxay xannibaan balaadhinta kulaylka kaliya
